Give the business a name of your own. The app never invents one for you, so the records stay yours.
Add a branch, outlet, or project
Every business unit keeps its own Plan and Actual books. Add one unit before recording transactions.

Select and manage your business ventures and active branches or outlets. Each venture\'s data is fully isolated — transactions, reports, and backups are all independent. Removing one venture does not affect any other.

Plan (budget/RAB) and Actual (cash on hand) books are strictly separated. Fill in the Plan before launching as a cost simulation, record Actual during operations, then compare both in Reports → Comparison tab to judge your planning accuracy.

See your cash balance, net profit, and money in and out at a glance. If the balance looks negative while you still have money on hand, the opening capital is probably missing: record it as Money in under \"Setoran Modal Pemilik\" (owner capital).

Every expense is sorted automatically into expense categories tailored to your industry (inventory stock, ingredients, wages, rent, packaging, or operations). Watch your highest spending areas to protect profit margins.

Choose Money in or Money out, then a category. The category decides the kind of record: owner capital is not counted as income, and owner drawings and equipment purchases are not counted as expenses. Add volume and unit if you want the unit price calculated.
Everything you have recorded lives in the History tab on the bottom bar, with search and filters for money in, money out, and unpaid.
Profit, Loss and Cash Flow answers \"what did I make\", Feasibility and Capital answers \"is this worth continuing\", and Actual vs Target answers \"how far did actual drift from plan\".

Net profit = operating income − operating cost. Because every record is cash, profit equals operating cash flow. Owner capital, drawings and equipment purchases never change profit; they show under financing or investing cash flow.
BEP, Unit Cost (HPP), and Profit Margins

Break-even rupiah: the minimum revenue that avoids a loss. Break-even volume: the minimum units/servings that covers every cost. Unit Cost (HPP): what one unit costs you to produce or buy — selling above it yields gross profit. B/C ratio: revenue divided by cost; above 1 the business is viable. Fill in the assumptions under Edit Assumptions to make these indicators appear.
Mark every guide unseen, so each page explains itself again the next time you open it.
Walk through the main features again.

Connect your Google Account to back up business records into private Google Drive storage (drive.appdata) securely. There is no third-party server — backups live entirely in your own Google Drive, in a hidden folder that only this app can access.

All backups are encrypted with your custom passphrase using AES-256-GCM. Without this passphrase, backups cannot be opened — not even by the app developer. Keep it somewhere safe. The local database can also be reset at any time.

Create separate business units — for example one called \"Grocery Store\", another \"Coffee Shop\", another \"Repair Workshop\". Each business has its own categories, units, and branches that never mix.
Register specific branches, outlets, or projects with their operational timeframes. Each unit has its own ledger. Feasibility reports (BEP, HPP) are calculated per unit.

Download the Mankeu template from Export, fill it in Excel, then pick the file here. Only the Mankeu template can be imported; its contents are added to the selected business unit after you review the preview.

Cash flow shows money that actually came in and went out. Operating cash covers daily buying and selling; investing cash covers equipment and asset purchases; financing cash covers owner capital and owner drawings.

Export records to an Excel workbook (.xlsx) or a PDF report for print archiving. AES-256-GCM encrypted local backups can be saved to phone storage, and cloud backups to your private Google Drive. Back up regularly — especially before switching phones or closing accounting periods.

Switch between Light, Dark, or System theme. Choose Indonesian or English. Adjust animation speed: Full for smooth transitions, Reduced for slower devices. Haptic feedback and tap sounds can also be toggled here.

Mankeu is an offline-first financial management and bookkeeping app for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs). It helps shop owners, food stalls, restaurants, and service providers record transactions, build a projected budget, and calculate break-even (BEP), unit cost (HPP), profit margins, and working capital without an internet connection.
